originalAlarm.description: `curr` could be null (null value originating from line 65) and is dereferenced.

model:
(define-fun CONFIG_FEATURE_LS_RECURSIVE () Bool
  false)
(define-fun CONFIG_FEATURE_LS_SORTFILES () Bool
  true)
reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (NEW, OVER-CONSTRAINED): Same bug as PRODUCT_63/81 — 'curr' from malloc at line 65 could be NULL and is dereferenced at line 66 ('curr->val = rand() % 10'). Genuine potential null dereference with no NULL check. NEW BUG: The known vbdb bug for 2631486f1bf.c is MemoryLeak when SORTFILES && RECURSIVE. OVER-CONSTRAINED: The malloc and dereference are in unconditional main() code, unguarded by any #ifdef. The null dereference can occur for any combination of LS_RECURSIVE and LS_SORTFILES. The presence condition requiring LS_RECURSIVE=false and LS_SORTFILES=true excludes three other equally-vulnerable flag combinations.
